groups.completedEvidence: Latest CI commit 83adb7b passed 90 Node tests and browser smoke. Added tests/tax-existing-tools.test.mjs: 11 independent baseline expected-value cases for the 11 existing tax tools plus VAT, house-tax and land-tax guardrail cases. The 131 land-tax browser cases remain 0 failures. These are initial baselines, not full boundary/identity/annual matrices; historical 130+ source rows remain unrecovered.

acceptanceRule: 所有測試案例必須有唯一ID、輸入、獨立計算的預期值、實際值、差異、法源/公式依據、測試時間及執行版本；通過數量不等於完整性，未通過或無證據不得宣稱可正式投入使用。
